lines.zh: 我的身子像一团被搅过的形状。
lines.en: My body is a shape that got stirred.

lines.zh: 我迈着不太对称的步子。
lines.en: My steps do not match each other.

lines.zh: 我嘴里念着听不懂的音。
lines.en: I mutter sounds that mean nothing.

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: My shadow wobbles on the ground.
I shuffle toward you.
I sway my head as I walk.
I have no fixed direction.
My feet seem to move on their own.

lines.zh: 我路过一块石头，绕了两圈。
lines.en: I pass a stone and circle it twice.
I do not know where I am.
I take one more step your way.
I stand with my mouth still moving.
I let out a string of odd noises.
My eyes look two different ways.
I do not know what I am.
I turn in a circle.
I raise a hand and drop it.

lines.zh: 我盯着你看，什么都不说。
lines.en: I stare at you and say nothing.
I shift my round body a little.
The word never comes.
I smile, and it comes out wrong.
I scratch my own head.
I start chanting again.
The sound rises and falls.
This place will not stay quiet.
I stare at you with my mouth open.
I say something and you do not react.
You have a smell.
I tilt my head and lean in.

lines.zh: 你身上有皮革和沙的味道。
lines.en: You smell of leather and sand.
What was my name again?
My name is long and hard to say.
I grin at you, all teeth.
You are not smiling.
I keep talking.
It does not matter if you are tired of it.
I pat your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我是用沙和皮革换来的。
lines.en: I was traded for sand and leather.
I cry out, off key.
I topple over.
I get up, still chanting.

lines.zh: 十六块沙换来的蛋，就这么打我。
lines.en: An egg bought with sixteen sand, and you hit it.
My voice goes shrill.

lines.zh: 我不太明白发生了什么。
lines.en: I do not quite understand what happened.
I still come toward you.
I take a hit and keep grinning.
This is not fun.
Food? Give it here.
My mouth is bigger than you think.

lines.zh: 这点东西，塞不满我的嘴。
lines.en: That won't fill my mouth.
More? More?
I sniff your hands.
I bit my own tongue.
I still want it.
Give it and I will stop chanting.
I am not very good at chewing.
I headbutt into you.
We both go crooked.
I bounce once off the ground, laughing.
My hand lands on you.
I bounce off and come back.
I bump without caring.

lines.zh: 地上的东西都被我撞翻了。
lines.en: I knock things over as I go.
My body is a little sticky.
Do not let me hit you again.
I cannot work this out.
Ask me something else.
I can only chant my name.

lines.zh: 我们站在一起，声音更大。
lines.en: Standing together, the noise is louder.
The other one tilts its head too.
We look at each other and laugh.

lines.zh: 我们都不知道在笑什么。
lines.en: Neither of us knows why.
I turn a circle.
It turns too.
Neither of us can stop.
I pick it up and put it in my mouth.
What is this?
I look, then lick it.
I toss it behind me.
I cannot hold it.
It falls into my clothes.
I carry it in my teeth.

lines.zh: 我咬了一口才想起来问。
lines.en: I bite first and ask later.
You hit me?
My mouth is wide.
I chant a line, lower now.
I grab your clothes.
I do not know why I am fighting.
But I will.

lines.zh: 我这副身子，是拿沙子换的。
lines.en: This body of mine was traded for sand.
Sixteen sand blocks bought me out.

lines.zh: 我嘴里念着名字，脚下乱走。
lines.en: I chant my name and wander on unsteady feet.
I will fight anyway.

lines.zh: 十六块沙子五张皮，换来的。
lines.en: Sixteen sand and five leather. That's my price.
I'm not hurrying; I'm just following.
I chase you, chanting my name.
You run steadier than me.
I bump into a tree.
I go around and keep coming.
My voice gets louder.
I grin, all teeth.
I catch a branch.
I let it go.
I chase you in a circle.
This is a good game.
When you stop, I stop.
I claw at you.
I shout a word.
That one missed.
My forehead is harder than your fist.
I laugh.

lines.zh: 我抹了一下嘴角，沙子和皮革味。
lines.en: I wipe my mouth; sand and leather.
You do not taste very good.

lines.zh: 别跑，我的爪子可不讲道理。
lines.en: Don't run. My claws don't do manners.

lines.zh: 有人在商人那里换了我。
lines.en: Someone traded for me at the merchant's.

lines.zh: 沙子、皮革，然后我就来了。
lines.en: Sand, leather, and there I was.

lines.zh: 我出现时带着一串怪声。
lines.en: I arrive with a string of odd noises.
I stand a little way off.

lines.zh: 沙子换来的身子，走哪算哪。
lines.en: A body bought with sand, I wander where I can.
First I chant my name.
The name is too long.
I forget halfway through.
I wobble to a stand.
This area gains one more voice.

lines.zh: 我用十六块沙子和五张皮换来。
lines.en: I cost sixteen sand and five leather.

lines.zh: 我从商人的手里跳到地上。
lines.en: I hop from the merchant's hands to the ground.

lines.zh: 我把这里当成了自己的地方。
lines.en: I take this place as mine.
I look around first, then decide.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的衣服，我乱跳。
lines.en: Fire catches my clothes and I hop about.

lines.zh: 我摔成一团，半天才散开。
lines.en: I land in a heap and take a while to unfold.
I swallow water and bubbles come out.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我吹得滚了很远。
lines.en: The blast rolls me far away.

lines.zh: 一支箭插在我身上，我拔了出来。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in me and I pull it out.
A flash of light and my voice stops.

lines.zh: 我饿得连名字都念不动。
lines.en: Too hungry to chant my name.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我的声音抖了。
lines.en: Lightning hits and my voice shakes.

lines.zh: 我掉下去，声音也听不见了。
lines.en: I fall, and the sound is gone.
